verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a first-party screenshot capability that returns viewport, full-page, or offset captures in PNG, JPEG, or WebP. That clearly covers full-page capture. The 'offset' capture and 'choose the capture area' wording only imply region selection; nothing documents capturing a user-specified rectangle or a CSS-selected element. missing for 10: explicit documentation of capturing a specific selected area (element/selector or arbitrary region bounds), independent or hands-on corroboration of screenshot output.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture a screenshot of a full page or a specific selected area

citations.quote: Render an exact URL or a resolved site page and return a viewport, full-page, or offset PNG capture.
Capture a URL as an inline PNG, JPEG, or WebP data URL, choose the capture area, and handle overlays, target headers, and deadlines.
Scrape a page into Markdown, HTML, a screenshot, images, or CSS-selected fields in one request.
